accepted.question_text: Performance Metrics & Benchmarking to Support Modularization Business Case Analysis: Which key performance metrics can be used for business case analysis of modular facility/component construction? These performance metrics would include relevant industry data, addressing-at a minimum-the impact of modularization on safety, quality, and productivity.
accepted.context_brief: Performance Metrics & Benchmarking to Support Modularization Business Case Analysis

evidence.quote: Which key performance metrics can be used for business case analysis of modular facility/component construction? These performance metrics would include relevant industry data, addressing-at a minimum-the impact of modularization on safety, quality, and productivity.

accepted.question_text: Controlling Scaffolding Costs: How can the industry effectively reduce, plan, and manage scaffolding costs by means of the following: • eliminating teardown and rebuilds • using best-of-breed planning systems for multidiscipline builds • moving certain modular scaffold builds to the yards to be included with shipment • initiating constructability to justify permanent platforms versus bulk scaffolds • evaluating the tradeoffs between JLG/scissor-type access versus fixed scaffolding.
accepted.context_brief: Controlling Scaffolding Costs

evidence.quote: How can the industry effectively reduce, plan, and manage scaffolding costs by means of the following: • eliminating teardown and rebuilds • using best-of-breed planning systems for multidiscipline builds • moving certain modular scaffold builds to the yards to be included with shipment • initiating constructability to justify permanent platforms versus bulk scaffolds • evaluating the tradeoffs between JLG/scissor-type access versus fixed scaffolding.

accepted.question_text: Integrated Project Delivery for Industrial Projects: Which best practice can offer a step-change in the industry's experience-based project execution paradigm (i.e., design-bid-build) and, thus, improve collaboration among all project team members (e.g., owner, designers, contractors, and trade partners).
